verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://developer.vanta.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 as a Vanta Developer Hub index. Doc pages are served as .md files that point agents to that index. Vanta also publishes agentskills.io-spec skill files and a docs MCP server that serves every page as a skill.md resource. missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, no independent user reports of agents consuming these docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.vanta.com/llms.txt # Vanta Developer Hub
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://developer.vanta.com/llms.txt
Vanta publishes agentskills.io-spec skill files that give your AI coding tool Vanta-specific guidance. Install them with one command or add the Vanta Developer Docs MCP server.
The MCP server at `https://developer.vanta.com/mcp` exposes search over the developer docs and serves every page as a `skill.md` resource.
